title: How Long Does a Jar of Night Cream Last? Sizes and Cost per Month
ex: A 30 g jar lasts about 6 to 8 weeks at a pea-sized amount nightly. Jar life by size, and what each Mirc Glow cream costs per month.
rt: How Long Does Night Cream Last? Jar Life & Cost | Mirc Glow
rd: How long does night cream last? Jar life for 10 g, 15 g, 25 g and 30 g jars at a pea-sized amount nightly, plus the cost per month of each Mirc Glow cream.
keyword: how long does night cream last
quick: Used once a night in a pea-sized amount, a 10 g jar lasts about 2 to 3 weeks, 15 g about 3 to 4 weeks, 25 g about 5 to 6 weeks and 30 g about 6 to 8 weeks. Using it morning and night roughly halves that.
facts: 30 g lasts about 6 to 8 weeks at a pea nightly
